title: Restocking share by return timing for HMO straight-tip catheters: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
For straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) returned from a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a share of the restocking basis is withheld from the credit. That share depends on how long after delivery the warehouse accepted the return.

For a return credit on non-covered straight-tip catheter units of a Commercial HMO program that this policy settles, and only for such a credit, the credit covers the accepted returned units this policy allocates to the customer's own purchase, at the price and less the restocking charge this policy states; every self-pay return credit remains under the base rule.

## Schedule

The days are counted in calendar days from the delivery date on the returned refill's proof of delivery to the date the warehouse accepted the return.

| Return accepted | Withheld from the credit |
|---|---|
| more than 30 days after delivery | one fifth (0.2) of the restocking basis |
| more than 14 but no more than 30 days after delivery | one tenth (0.1) of the restocking basis |
| 14 days or fewer after delivery, or no proof of delivery or acceptance date on file | nothing |

The returned refill is the shipment named on the program's latest return receipt.

## Boundaries and arithmetic (hypothetical)

| Days from delivery to acceptance | Withheld |
|---|---|
| 14 | nothing |
| 15 | one tenth |
| 30 | one tenth |
| 31 | one fifth |

On a restocking basis of 50.00 USD, one tenth is 5.00 USD and one fifth is 10.00 USD.
